Title: Ecommerce Executive - Events and Campaigns
Description:
Ecommerce Executive - Events and Campaigns

Contract type: Permanent

Location: Hatfield (Hybrid working - 3 days in the office)

Working hours per week: 40 hours

Level: Associate

Reports to: Manager - Events and Campaigns

Application Closing Date: Friday 16th October 2026

About us

Our mission is to deliver joy in every shop, through unbeatable choice, unrivalled service, and reassuringly good value. We’re also on a mission to empower our business with smart technology; we've recently launched our AI Academy, providing a tailored AI learning journey for every colleague.

We’re Ocado Retail, a market-leading joint venture between Ocado Group and M&S, and the world’s largest dedicated online supermarket, ocado.com. Not only is Ocado the only place to shop a full range of M&S food online, it’s also the home to the widest online supermarket range in the UK and champion of small, independent brands. We’re also the brains behind Zoom by Ocado, our same-day grocery delivery service.


About the team and the role

We want to make the shopping experience for our customers as simple, smart and inspiring as possible, whilst hitting commercial goals. As part of the Merchandising team, it's our job to inspire customers and ensure all events follow a smooth customer journey through brilliant shop-keeping.

As an Ecommerce Executive, you will play a key role in planning, briefing, executing and optimising onsite Events & Campaigns on Ocado.com. You will collaborate with various stakeholders and creative teams to deliver campaigns on time, use merchandising levers to optimise events to drive trade and continuously review and act upon performance data.


What you’ll do

  • Develop an in-depth knowledge of customers and their shopping behaviours of events, using a suite of data and insight sources and tools.

  • Update and manage the top level media execution onsite including the homepage, checkout walk, slot booking and various other pages.

  • Ensure that all Events & Campaigns are up to date and relevant for the customer closely following the Ecommerce sitemap and Customer Marketing Calendar.

  • Use various systems to launch, optimise and update campaigns including media assets and tagging.

  • Reviewing, manipulating & analysing data to report on Ecommerce KPI performance for using available insight tools. Inferring customer behaviour from the data and presenting these insights to key stakeholders on a regular basis along with actionable recommendations to improve performance.

  • Use the merchandising levers available to optimise whilst also supporting in scoping & briefing Insight Teams on additional data required to effectively track customer performance to optimise further.

  • Build strong working relationships amongst peers across Customer & Commercial including Buying, Trade Marketing, Creative, Supplier Services, Pricing & Promotions, Product & Propositions, Merchandising and SFM to ensure we are working towards the right priorities and aligned outcomes.

  • Keeping up to date on event analysis within the market, drawing on inspiration from competitors or other ecommerce sites to suggest optimisation plans that drives event growth within Ocado.


Who you are

  • You’ll have excellent attention to detail skills, with an eye for detail to be able to provide accurate and high quality work.

  • Competent and confident working on internal systems, spreadsheets and powerpoint presentations.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • PC literate, including Excel, as well as a quick learner, as the role will require the use of a number of different internal systems

  • A problem solver who is organised and able to balance multiple priorities at once

  • Customer focused as the more you can understand our customers’ needs, the easier and more fulfilling this job will be

  • Results orientated – Proactive and focused on delivery of successful outcomes for the team and ORL. Bases decisions on solid rationale supported by data and insights, takes ownership of issues and decisions.


What’s in it for you

By joining Ocado Retail, you’ll have the chance to experience life at the world’s largest online retailer, work with an amazing bunch of people who challenge what’s possible each day, and grow your skills and career in online retail. You'll also be part of our AI Academy, a dedicated learning journey designed to empower every colleague with the smart technology skills of the future.

If that’s not enough to tempt you, you’ll also get access to loads of great benefits to sweeten the deal. Here’s a taste of what we offer:

Health & Wellbeing: Private medical insurance with option to add your family, Digital GP appointments, market-leading family policies, mental health support, discounted gym memberships, dental insurance, and more.

Spend & Save: Annual bonus scheme split between personal and business objectives, recognition with reward platform, up to 7% matched pension contributions, 15% Ocado discount, 20% M&S discount, free breakfast every day in the office, electric vehicle leasing scheme, and free shuttle bus from Hatfield station to the office.

Never miss the moments that matter: Hybrid working, 26 days holiday plus 8 flexible bank holidays, options to buy extra holiday, 2 weeks work from anywhere, and lifestyle break opportunities.


Our Hiring Process

Lucky for us, we receive a high volume of applications and genuinely appreciate the time and effort invested by every candidate. To ensure a fair and thorough process, every application is reviewed by a member of our team. If your skills and experience are a strong match, a Talent Partner will contact you to discuss the role and guide you through the next steps of our hiring process.

Your Application and AI

In the spirit of innovation, we welcome you to use AI tools in your application, just as we use them in our own business at Ocado Retail. However, as you leverage this technology, please don't lose sight of the most important element: your unique self. Your experiences, passions, and personality are what truly set you apart. Ensure that your application still authentically conveys who you are and why you're a great fit for us.

Everyone’s welcome

We’re an equal opportunities employer, which means that we make sure all potential colleagues are treated fairly and equally. We want to ensure everyone has a fair chance to apply; if you need this job description in an alternative format (e.g., larger print, different document type, etc.), please reach out to us at careers@ocadoretail.com and we'll be happy to assist you, and if you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know on the application form.

Title: Growth Accounts and Agency Lead
Description:
Growth Accounts and Agency Lead

Contract type: Permanent

Location: Hatfield (Hybrid working - 2 days in our Hatfield office and 1 day working with agencies in London)

Working hours per week: 40 hours

Level: Lead

Reporting into: Retail Media Director

Application Closing Date: Friday 9th October 2026

About us

Our mission is to deliver joy in every shop, through unbeatable choice, unrivalled service, and reassuringly good value.

We’re Ocado Retail, a market-leading joint venture between Ocado Group and M&S, and the world’s largest dedicated online supermarket, ocado.com. We’re also the brains behind Zoom by Ocado, our same-day grocery delivery service.

About the team and the role

The Growth Accounts and Agency Lead role will focus on accelerating revenue growth by managing and expanding our mid-tier and growth suppliers and driving strategic partnerships with media agencies. Your role covers selling the full Ocado Ads portfolio, including the Beet proprietary data and insights platform, to our CPG partners.

You will be a commercial leader with a deep understanding of retail media, digital advertising, and the grocery landscape.

What you’ll do

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of dedicated Media Planning Managers and Associates, ensuring high performance, professional development, and strong team morale.

  • Oversee team workload, capacity planning, and resource allocation to optimize account coverage and maximize revenue potential.

  • Drive a culture of accountability, commercial excellence, and proactive client engagement within the team.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and training sessions to ensure the team is leveraging best practices in retail media and client relationship management.

Strategic Growth and Account Management

  • Own and exceed ambitious revenue targets across a portfolio of high-value, high-potential mid-tier and growth accounts and agency partners, across retail media and data.

  • Collaborate with buyers and suppliers on their joint business plans (JBPs) for mid-tier clients, outlining strategic growth opportunities, product adoption, and campaign excellence.

  • Act as the primary commercial relationship holder for key advertisers, fostering deep, long-term partnerships at the senior level (CMO, Head of Media, etc.).

  • Identify and convert opportunities for upselling and cross-selling the full suite of Ocado Ads products, including sponsored search, programmatic display, and innovative custom solutions.

Agency Engagement and Development

  • Lead the commercial strategy and engagement with media and programmatic agencies.

  • Educate agency teams on the unique value proposition of Ocado Ads, our first-party data capabilities, and the Ocado Retail customer journey.

  • Establish Ocado Ads as a must-buy platform within agency planning cycles, ensuring deep integration into their clients' yearly media strategies.

  • Educate and enable the wider Ocado Ads team to lead account level agency discussions to drive incremental revenue.

Collaboration and Market Insight

  • Work closely with the Proposition Lead, Commercial and Customer teams to translate client needs into product roadmap suggestions and to effectively package and launch new offerings.

  • Provide accurate sales forecasting and pipeline management for the team’s combined book of business to leadership.

  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and industry changes to proactively adapt commercial strategies.

Who you are

  • Proven experience in digital advertising, media sales, or account management.

  • Experience in a leadership/senior commercial role.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding large sales quotas and driving significant revenue growth.

  • Deep expertise in Retail Media, eCommerce, or programmatic advertising, with an understanding of the grocery sector a strong plus.

  • Exceptional ability to build rapport, influence, and negotiate at the senior executive level, both with clients and agencies.

  • Strong analytical skills, capable of using data and insights to create compelling commercial narratives.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Experience managing and closing complex, multi-year commercial agreements.
